description: This Java source file defines a shell component for managing MockKeypad devices via command-line interface, including listing, adding, tampering, and battery status controls.

classes.name: KeypadDeviceShell
classes.description: Shell component class for managing MockKeypad devices, providing CLI commands for listing, adding, tampering, and battery status management.

classes.name: NameValueProvider
classes.description: Inner class extending DeviceNameProvider to supply device names for CLI options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all registered keypads with their details in a table format.

methods.name: addKeypad
methods.description: Adds a new keypad device with a specified or default name.

methods.name: tamper
methods.description: Sets a specified keypad as tampered.

methods.name: tamperRestore
methods.description: Restores a specified keypad from tampered state.

methods.name: tamperToggle
methods.description: Toggles the tampered state of a specified keypad.

methods.name: lowBattery
methods.description: Marks a specified keypad as having low battery.

methods.name: lowBatteryRestore
methods.description: Restores a specified keypad from low battery state.

methods.name: lowBatteryToggle
methods.description: Toggles the low battery state of a specified keypad.
